thread:
Morgan: Heads-up: HyperLane sent options for H100 replenishment. Two lanes: sea (12-16w) or air (3-5w). Air adds ~27%/unit. They can also host an RMA kit pool at FRA for quicker DOA swaps. PO/manifest on drive.

Sanjay: Can we absorb a 48-unit air arrival in eu-west? Cluster queues are heavy.

Kevin: We can free ~8-10% Dedicated in eu-west if we defer noncritical batch runs. Staging/network handoff is the bottleneck 3: depot handoff windows need to align with rack install team.

Amira (HyperLane): We recommend split shipment (approx 60/40 sea/air) to balance cost vs risk. FRA depot can hold express RMA kits with 48-72h swap SLA; needs deposit and signed SLA addendum. We can pre-assign serial blocks to speed processing.

Rachel: Ballpark cost: full air = +$450k. Split (72 sea / 48 air) ~+$180k + depot holding fees (~$12k/mo). CFO sign needed. Seems affordable vs potential outage.

Morgan: Leaning split. Request: reserve an 8-unit air canary to eu-west to validate deploy path. Ops: can you provision canary and confirm transfer window? Also confirm RMA behavior for DOA 5: depot swap vs courier replacement.

Sanjay: Can carve out 8 canary nodes in ~10-14 days once AWB + serials are provided and routing approved. Bulk sea will land AMS and needs ~5 business days for customs and kitting.

Amira (HyperLane): Will DM AWB + serial CSV EOD + post manifest link. Depot note: immediate swap for warranty units if SLA addendum signed; otherwise courier replacement with longer lead times.

Kevin: Reminder: FRA customs sometimes ask for extra docs even with HS code 8471. ops-bot, add HS certificate checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder added: "attach HS certificate + proof of purchase for FRA routing".

Morgan: Looping Legal for SLA addendum and Ops for transient burst quota on Dedicated pool for 72h during roll-in. Attaching PO snippet:

```
PO: PO-98485
qty: 120 H100
split-plan: 72 sea / 48 air (8-unit air canary)
ETA-air-canary: ~3-5w
ETA-sea-bulk: ~12-16w
RMA-depot-hold: FRA, 20 kits for 90d (requires SLA addendum)
```

Rachel: I'll draft cost memo + quick unit-economics + risk table.

Amira (HyperLane): Proforma AWB and serial block will be sent tonight. We can offer prepaid depot hold quote if you want earlier reservation.

Sanjay: After AWB/serials, I'll prepare canary build plan and network handoff window. Need install crew availability for the 48-72h swap SLA.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Amira send AWB/serials (EOD) 2) Legal review SLA addendum 3) Ops prep canary and request transient burst quota (10-14d). Thanks. :thumbsup:
